text:
A question for the Germans 😊

I’m planning to apply to a partner visa soon and received a “Beglaubigter Ausdruck aus dem Geburtenregister” (certified extract from the birth register, bilingual German/English) instead of a Geburtsurkunde.

Has anyone used this document before? I understand that it is basically even more official than a regular birth certificate but I wondered if the clerks may reject it because the title is a different one?

Did anyone have any experiences with it?

Thank you!🙏
